name: Virtual Camera Optimization for Mirror Reflections
definition: A method to render mirror reflections in 3D Gaussian Splatting by modeling reflections as physically-based virtual cameras, optimizing the mirror plane to resolve multi-view inconsistencies caused by misinterpreting reflections as virtual spaces.
summary: Virtual Camera Optimization for Mirror Reflections renders accurate reflections in 3D Gaussian Splatting using virtual cameras and rasterization, avoiding the blurriness of standard methods and the slowness of ray tracing.
